sentiment: What we build slips out of our hands — into archives, strangers' browsers, backups — still running long after we stop.

stories.title: A browser-native classic Visual Basic VB6 IDE
stories.summary: A thirty-year-old language resurrected inside a browser tab, running for people who never installed it. The tool outlived its platform and quietly moved into a new one, no permission asked.

stories.title: In the wake of Tippett Studios' closure, a digital archive appears online
stories.summary: When the studio shut its doors, someone gathered the work and put it online rather than let it evaporate. A company ends; the things it made keep going, shelved where anyone can find them.

stories.title: The Tao of Backup
stories.summary: An old, half-serious meditation on copies: the data you keep is only ever the data you copied more than once. To let go of the original is not loss — it is the whole point of having made a second.
